source: ETOPO 2022 Global Relief Model, 60 arc-second surface elevation
publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
method: Every sixth point of the 60 arc-second grid (0.1° spacing); per 0.5° cell the mean of the 25 samples; sea set to 0. Peaks inside a cell are higher than its mean. A coarse terrain model for route profiles and a last-resort site elevation — not for obstacle clearance.
